gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma confirmed by histopathology or molecular pathology;

candidate_evidence.quote: to evaluate the efficacy and safety of hypofractionated concurrent radiotherapy followed by sequential temozolomide after surgery in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.
The experimental group received hypofractionated radiotherapy with a total dose of 52.5Gy, 3.5 Gy/ fraction, 15 fractions, 5 fractions per week, and temozolomide was given for 21 days.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma confirmed by histopathology or molecular pathology;

role_evidence.quote: The experimental group received hypofractionated radiotherapy with a total dose of 52.5Gy, 3.5 Gy/ fraction, 15 fractions, 5 fractions per week, and temozolomide was given for 21 days.
The control group received conventional fractionated radiotherapy with a dose of 60Gy, 2Gy per fraction, 30 fractions, 5 fractions per week, and temozolomide was given for a total of 42 days.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: MGMT promoter methylation expression (positive or negative).

coder_notes: Radiotherapy fractionation trial (Phase NA); temozolomide is not a registered intervention but is given in both arms. Its concurrent schedule differs between arms (21 vs 42 days, following the RT course), so per R2 coded established_therapy_experiment; soc_backbone would also be defensible. Either way no candidate (S6 fails). Control group arm is type OTHER and receives existing standard treatment -> control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Arm labels taken as 'Experimental group' and 'Control group' (text before the colon).
